definitions.explanation: Items needed for a particular purpose or activity. Almost always appears as the second element of a compound specifying the type of supplies.

examples.japanese: {事務|じむ}{用品|ようひん}を{買|か}いに{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going to buy office supplies.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}{用品|ようひん}は{入学前|にゅうがくまえ}にそろえておく。
examples.english: School supplies should be gathered before enrollment.

examples.japanese: {防災|ぼうさい}{用品|ようひん}を{常|つね}に{備|そな}えておくことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to always have disaster preparedness supplies on hand.

notes:
USAGE:
Rarely used alone; almost always forms compounds with a preceding word that specifies the type: {事務|じむ}{用品|ようひん} (office supplies), {日用|にちよう}{品|ひん} (daily necessities), {学校|がっこう}{用品|ようひん} (school supplies). Functions similarly to the English suffix "-supplies" or "-goods."

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {事務|じむ}{用品|ようひん}: office supplies
- {学校|がっこう}{用品|ようひん}: school supplies
- {防災|ぼうさい}{用品|ようひん}: disaster preparedness supplies
- {介護|かいご}{用品|ようひん}: nursing care supplies
- {台所|だいどころ}{用品|ようひん}: kitchen supplies
- {衛生|えいせい}{用品|ようひん}: hygiene/sanitary supplies
